reviews.text: A huge thank you for Gauffrette 🥰 She was pampered like a little queen! We received updates, photos, and above all, lots of cuddles. We felt completely reassured while we were away ❤️ We highly recommend them!

I highly recommend her! She takes care of my two cats, Harry & Potter, and everything is going wonderfully 🥰 You can really tell she loves animals and takes the time to look after them properly. I always leave with peace of mind knowing they're in good hands ❤️ Thank you for your kindness and professionalism, Harry & Potter adore you! 🐱🐱

A huge thank you to Florie for putting me in touch with Thomas, who took excellent care of my cat! Thanks to his photo and video reports, along with voice messages, I was able to follow his daily life.

I will definitely use Pause Papouilles again :))

Hello
The service is incredible, you can feel the love and passion.
My cat was delighted.
I left for 12 days with complete peace of mind.

And I came back to a cat in seventh heaven.
I will definitely use your services again without hesitation.
Marc from the 11th arrondissement

Legendary patience with my very unsociable cat, Suzette 🥹❤️ With gentleness, attention, and little treats, she managed to win her heart… and mine at the same time! A lovely, serious, and caring person. I recommend her without hesitation!
Top-notch care with regular updates. Our Booboo is back from vacation every time!

We entrusted four dogs to Pause Papouilles. Everything went very well.
The dogs are rested and relaxed. We'll do it again as soon as possible! 🐶🐾🐕

My dog ​​Monty loves his walks! Whether it's in the park, the forest, or the city, with friends or alone, he has a blast every time he goes out. He always comes home happy, well-fed... and usually ends up taking a long nap when he gets back! Thank you!

An exceptional overnight stay! 🐱💕 My kitten Nuage was pampered from beginning to end. I received lots of updates and photos, I loved it! He's found his official foster mom!
Thank you for all your kindness and love. I will definitely use PausePapouilles again without hesitation!

An amazing pet sitter! Tooka and Naboo have found a new friend, even though they usually hate other humans.
Thank you so much!
Florie is a perfect catsitter - excellent communication, she takes lots of beautiful photos to reassure us and everything goes wonderfully every time, I recommend her 1000%!

A very positive experience with the cat-sitting service during last week's intense heatwave. I was away and greatly appreciated their proactive approach: they even offered to make a second visit to check that everything was alright in my very hot apartment. Everything was done for his comfort and safety, with great care: refreshing toys in bowls of water, ice cubes in his bowls, damp towels and gloves to keep him cool… You can feel their genuine commitment and kindness.
Thanks to all these thoughtful touches, I sincerely believe it prevented a potentially dangerous situation. I also received excellent advice on how to cope with the heat. I will definitely use PausePapouilles again for Sugar this summer! Thank you!
A huge thank you to Thomas who looked after our little Brooklyn, an 8-year-old Shiba Inu. We received photos and videos after every walk! She loved it!

A huge thank you to Florie and Anaïs for taking such good care of Nina during the week I couldn't take her for her midday walk. The service was always very professional and punctual, with plenty of photos and videos of each walk, which was very reassuring. It was Nina's first experience with dog sitters, and I'm sure she'll be delighted to see them again if the opportunity arises. Thank you both for your help and kindness. We're so glad we found you! 😊

A truly wonderful pet sitter 🐾✨
Sweet, incredibly reliable, and so attentive, she truly pampers animals with love 💕
I have complete confidence in her and highly recommend her!

What can I say… a huge thank you to Sarah for her kindness and unconditional love for animals… Diego is going through a difficult time, having recently lost his brother, and is particularly sensitive and anxious. With Sarah, it was love at first sight, and he felt loved and reassured from beginning to end.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Communication is seamless, and the pet-sitting is very professionally organized (contract, rules). Everything you need to entrust your furry friend to her.
Thank you to Florie and Sarah 🙏🏼♥️
Very positive experience. I definitely wouldn't hesitate to call back if I ever need anything.

Anaïs was an amazing animal guardian— Her affection for animals is obvious. She left my space very neat and I was greeted by two happy floofs when I returned. Absolutely planning on using the service in the future, highly recommend!

I recently adopted a kitten and, unfortunately, I had to go on vacation shortly after. Florie took care of it with incredible dedication: she was gentle, attentive, and very reassuring. Thanks to her, I was able to leave with peace of mind, knowing my kitten was in good hands. I highly recommend her!

The Pause Papouilles team is helping me take Sam (my 3-year-old English bulldog, who can be quite stubborn and capricious at times) out towards the end of my pregnancy because I can no longer do it myself, and I'm thrilled! They're punctual, professional, everyone is super friendly, and most importantly, my dog ​​is very happy with his walks and the games he can play during them. I even get a little photo report after each outing ☺️
